req.title: Emit Swagger UI
req.statement: The system shall serve interactive Swagger UI at GET /docs.

doc.reasoning: R-TASK-020 requires GET /docs to serve interactive Swagger UI with HTTP 2xx. Tests cover: (1) positive EP — nominal GET /docs returns 200 with HTML content containing Swagger UI markers; (2) negative NEG — wrong HTTP method (POST /docs) returns 405; (3) boundary BVA — response Content-Type header is exactly 'text/html; charset=utf-8' and body contains key Swagger identifiers to catch mutations that change the route path or response type. Each test uses FastAPI TestClient in-process, asserts exact status codes and content markers to maximise mutation kill rate.

tests.name: test_swagger_ui_get_docs_returns_200_with_html
preconditions: FastAPI app is initialised with docs_url='/docs' (default)
expected: Response body contains 'swagger' (case-insensitive) indicating Swagger UI is served
Response body contains 'Task Manager API' matching the app title
trace: R-TASK-020: system shall serve interactive Swagger UI at GET /docs
Expected outcome: HTTP 2xx response with expected payload
tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

def test_swagger_ui_get_docs_returns_200_with_html():
    client = TestClient(app)
    response = client.get("/docs")
    assert response.status_code == 200
    body = response.text
    assert "swagger" in body.lower()
    assert "Task Manager API" in body

test_swagger_ui_get_docs_returns_200_with_html()

    assert response.status_code == 405

tests.name: test_swagger_ui_content_type_and_body_markers
preconditions: FastAPI app is initialised with default Swagger UI settings
actions: Inspect Content-Type header and body for exact Swagger UI markers
expected: Body contains 'swagger-ui' string (exact Swagger UI CSS/JS identifier)
Body contains '/openapi.json' (the OpenAPI spec URL embedded in the UI)
trace: R-TASK-020: expected payload must be Swagger UI HTML
BVA: verifying exact content markers that distinguish Swagger UI from any other 200 HTML response
tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

def test_swagger_ui_content_type_and_body_markers():
    client = TestClient(app)
    response = client.get("/docs")
    assert response.status_code == 200
    content_type = response.headers.get("content-type", "")
    assert content_type.startswith("text/html")
    body = response.text
    assert "swagger-ui" in body
    assert "/openapi.json" in body

test_swagger_ui_content_type_and_body_markers()
